methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series G → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.25x) to $75M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Earth AI, a Series G infrastructure and logistics company founded by Roman Teslyuk, is the subject of this valuation analysis. The company has raised $20M to date. The comp universe for this sector remains sparse; no public or private comparable companies are available for direct benchmarking at this time, limiting triangulation depth.

Given the limited comp set, stage-progression methodology was applied. Using total capital raised ($20M) as a proxy baseline and scaling to an implied current valuation of $75M, a 1.25x multiplier typical of Series G advancement to the subsequent stage yields $94M. This methodology produces a single, primary valuation signal rather than a cross-method consensus.

The triangulated range spans $80M (low) to $108M (high), with a median of $94M. The narrow band reflects application of a single method and absence of market comparables to validate or refute the stage-progression output. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 1.25x step-up multiplier for Earth AI's specific risk profile and growth trajectory, and the absence of public market signals or peer valuations to anchor the analysis. Additional data on revenue, growth rate, unit economics, or identified private comps in infrastructure logistics would substantially improve conviction in this range.
